items.title: Confident manual run-through of the 3 Index Creator scenarios
items.detail: Drive Basic (30x5), Mid (30x9), and Complex (30x17) live; preflight clears prior index_*.csv/xlsx and warms the engine. Live-demo rule: let Preview finish before Run (single-threaded index server can stall).

items.title: Templates auto-match demo
items.detail: Show 12 Procurement / 12 Special Collections / 6 Registrar / 0 unmatched against the demo set using the saved BU templates.

items.title: Build AutoPDF Portable for the BU laptop
items.detail: Run docs\Make-Portable.ps1 and verify the 3 scenarios run with no Ollama and no internet (they do not use the LLM).

items.title: PP-OCRv5 via ONNX Runtime (RapidOcrNet)
items.detail: Bundled, offline, no-Python second OCR engine callable from the PowerShell/.NET layer like Tesseract. Toggle engine = tesseract|paddle-onnx and device = auto|cpu|cuda; Tesseract stays default. Plan approved 2026-06-22, implementation not started.

items.title: PP-OCRv6 model swap
items.detail: Drop in PP-OCRv6 ONNX models once they publish (RapidAI/RapidOCR #686, milestone v3.9.0) with no re-architecture.

items.title: Auto CPU fallback hardening
items.detail: Forced device=cuda on a CPU-only box must log a fallback warning and still complete; verify auto resolves to CPU when no GPU is present.

items.title: In-UI date-format picker
items.detail: Format currently lives in the recipe JSON (works, demo outputs MM/DD/YYYY) but there is no user-facing format control yet.

items.title: Per-row OnBase Document Type
items.detail: docTypeColumn is wired in the XML serializer but only the literal docTypeValue is exposed in the UI; add a column dropdown for mixed-type batches.

items.title: Multi-file to one OnBase document
items.detail: OnBase allows repeated <FilePath> inside one <NewDocument> to combine pages; today AutoPDF emits one <FilePath> per row.

items.title: Field-accurate validation against a live customer DIP
items.detail: Output matches Hyland's published 24.1 spec; matching a specific deployment's DIP config still requires that customer's import format.

items.title: Make the index server safe to overlap
items.detail: The index server is single-threaded; overlapping a Preview and a Run can stall it. Add run isolation / queueing so overlap is safe.

items.title: Index Creator template integration
items.detail: Templates already drive Splitter CSV; wiring template fields into the standalone Index Creator is still future work (deferred from Phase 2c).

items.title: Multi-sample / multi-doc-stack template authoring
items.detail: Smart Mapping authors against a single PDF today; author from several samples or a stacked document.

items.title: Maia / NEXUS / FileHQ batch extraction
items.detail: Let other QI projects call /api/template-apply-batch to extract fields from user-supplied PDFs; NEXUS could orchestrate Smart Mapping proposals across providers.

items.title: Migrate to allocated 8700-8709 port block
items.detail: Port 6969 predates the registry. Move into the 8700 block when AutoPDF starts consuming other ecosystem integrations.

items.title: CogniBase handoff
items.detail: AutoPDF-produced indexes and split documents could feed CogniBase's OnBase data lake as a structured ingestion source.
